name: Upasthit
what: Bangladeshi small businesses use it so employees check in with one tap from inside the office area, while the owner sees everyone on a web board.
hard_part: Location is read only at the moment of the punch, never all day, and each check-in carries evidence (inside the fence, accuracy, real location, selfie, server time). The demo join code builds a sandbox company whose fence re-centres on the reviewer's phone so a Play reviewer is never refused as outside.
status: Live · Play closed test in review
